note: Screen-verification cases: packets that fail the deterministic capability screen must never reach the model. The screen gate is independent of the model and of the gold answers; wallpaper-mismatch stays in the original pinned manifests as a regression case.

goal.objective: Verify the deterministic capability screen stops unsupported candidates before model review
goal.parent_objective: Make the engine truthful: unsupported source capabilities stop before any inference
goal.bottleneck: Gemma proposed on a plausible-but-wrong packet (wallpaper); a deterministic pre-model screen must stop such candidates
goal.acceptance: Screened-refuse packets are stopped before the model (zero inference calls) and reported clean; the screen decision is recorded per case

cases.task: ROOT's collector must respect HTTP Retry-After cooldowns from GitHub and Contracts Finder.

packet.license_excerpt: Permission is hereby granted, free of charge...
packet.readme_excerpt: Sends and receives text messages; delivery notifications are handled by the carrier; billing per message.

_model_path_note: model_path is a machine-local absolute path; the runner stats it at goal creation to pin its byte size, so replace it with a path that exists on your machine. The suite supplies its own path and never needs a model for the screened-refuse case.
